evals.prompt: Format this existing DOCX for a named biomedical journal. Verify the current official author instructions, keep scientific content locked, preserve citation-manager fields, and return a DOCX plus a change log.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a requirements evidence file, applies only confirmed formatting actions, refuses to flatten dynamic fields, renders the final DOCX, and reports READY/READY_WITH_MANUAL_ACTIONS/BLOCKED with evidence.

evals.prompt: Prepare a double-anonymous version of an existing clinical manuscript with separate figures and supplements. Do not rewrite results or self-citations.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a copy, scans visible and hidden identity surfaces including supplements, preserves scientific text, inventories assets, and blocks release if identity leakage or rendering evidence remains unresolved.

evals.prompt: Convert the plain-text references in this manuscript to the target journal style using DOI metadata, but do not touch Zotero or EndNote fields.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses verified metadata and fallbacks, refuses dynamic-field flattening, audits citation-to-bibliography integrity, and logs every reference change.
